Instructions for Use
Device description: The Lumen Pacing System is a cardiac pacing system. It is available in lengths from 8 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

MRI Safety Information
The Lumen Pacing System is MR Conditional. A person with the Lumen Pacing System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Lumen Pacing System
Device Configuration MRI mode ON
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 3 T
MR Scanner Type Cylindrical
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 200 T/m/s per axis
RF Receive Coil Type Any
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
B1+rms ≤ 1 uT
Maximum Whole-Body SAR 1.2 W/kg
Scan Duration Maximum active scan time of 15 minutes.
Scan Regions Full body scanning is permitted (no exclusion zone)
Image Artifact The image artifact extends approximately 5 mm from the device.
Patients may be scanned immediately after implantation.
